info.title: MaxP Platform — External HR & AI Integration API
info.description: Enterprise-grade Human Resources API for seamless integration with external ERP systems (Odoo, SAP), Biometric Attendance devices (ZKTeco), and Autonomous AI Agents (OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, n8n).

get.description:
Returns paginated list of employees with search and department filtering.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.description:
Create a new employee profile with full HR attributes, initial salary history, and optional user account linking.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

409.description: Duplicate employee number or user already linked

get.description:
Returns total count, active count, on-leave count, departments count, and department breakdown.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Returns full tree of departments, positions, and reporting manager relationships.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

get.summary: Get employee by ID or employeeNumber
get.description:
Fetch detailed profile of an employee.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

patch.description:
Update an employee profile. If baseSalary changes, a salary history audit row is automatically created. User account linking or unlinking is verified within the company.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

409.description: User already linked to another employee

post.description:
Terminate employee service safely (no hard delete). Sets status to TERMINATED, records lastWorkingDay and reason, and deactivates any linked user login.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

post.summary: Create or update employee from ERP
post.description:
Upsert an employee record from external systems.

**Required Scope:** `hr:employees:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

get.description:
Returns list of company departments with manager details and employee headcounts.

**Required Scope:** `hr:departments:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Returns active job titles and positions with department association and headcounts.

**Required Scope:** `hr:positions:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.description:
Batch endpoint for biometric devices (e.g. ZKTeco) to upload punches with automatic check-in/out resolution.

**Required Scope:** `hr:attendance:ingest` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

get.description:
Quickly inspect who is present, checked-in, or absent today.

**Required Scope:** `hr:attendance:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Aggregates present days, absent days, late minutes, early departures, and overtime for a date range.

**Required Scope:** `hr:attendance:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Fetch paginated leave requests with filters for status, employeeCode, and date range.

**Required Scope:** `hr:leaves:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.description:
Submit a leave request on behalf of an employee via AI or external system.

**Required Scope:** `hr:leaves:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

get.description:
Returns leave balance allocations, used days, and remaining balances per employee.

**Required Scope:** `hr:leaves:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.summary: Decide on leave request (Approve or Reject)
post.description:
Approve or reject a pending leave request using the panel workflow.

**Required Scope:** `hr:leaves:approve` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

get.description:
Returns historical payroll run batches with totals and calculation statuses.

**Required Scope:** `hr:payroll:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Detailed salary breakdown (base salary, allowances, deductions, net salary) for each employee in a run.

**Required Scope:** `hr:payroll:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

List active webhook subscription endpoints for the company.

**Required Scope:** `hr:write` (or `*`)

post.description:
Register a new webhook subscription endpoint.

**Required Scope:** `hr:write` (or `*`)

get.description:
Returns paginated list of employee financial advance requests with filtering by employeeCode, status, date range, and search.

**Required Scope:** `hr:advances:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Returns paginated list of employee manual and auto deductions with filtering by employeeCode, status, date range, and search.

**Required Scope:** `hr:deductions:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.description:
Creates a manual deduction or penalty for an employee.

**Required Scope:** hr:deductions:write (or hr:write, *)

get.description:
Returns paginated list of disciplinary warnings with filtering by employeeCode, status/severity, date range, and search.

**Required Scope:** `hr:warnings:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Returns paginated list of employee resignation requests and exit procedures with filtering by employeeCode, status, date range, and search.

**Required Scope:** `hr:resignations:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

Returns HR settings partitioned into panel-matching sections (workHours, leaves, attendance, geofence, payroll, notifications) with sensitive keys/phones masked.

**Required Scope:** hr:settings:read (or hr:read, *)

200.description: Masked HR settings grouped by sections

put.description:
Updates HR settings via safe section-level merge. Unpassed sections/fields are preserved. Masked phone/secret placeholders are never overwritten.

**Required Scope:** hr:settings:write (or hr:write, *)

patch.description:
Assigns a shift to an employee for a specific date without modifying database schema.

**Required Scope:** hr:shifts:write (or hr:write, *)

Corrects check-in/out timestamps and status. Automatically recalculates workHours and lateMinutes via the central panel service and cancels associated auto-deductions.

**Required Scope:** hr:attendance:write (or hr:write, *)

Updates an existing deduction.

**Required Scope:** hr:deductions:write (or hr:write, *)

get.description:
Lists bonuses and rewards with employeeCode, status, and date range filters.

**Required Scope:** hr:rewards:read (or hr:read, *)

post.description:
Creates a bonus or reward record for an employee.

**Required Scope:** hr:rewards:write (or hr:write, *)

Voids an applied/approved reward record before payroll processing. Requires mandatory reason.

**Required Scope:** hr:rewards:write (or hr:write, *)

reason.description: Mandatory explanation for voiding the reward

get.description:
Lists company shift definitions.

**Required Scope:** hr:shifts:read (or hr:read, *)

post.description:
Creates a new shift definition with start/end time and break duration.

**Required Scope:** hr:shifts:write (or hr:write, *)

patch.description:
Updates an existing shift definition.

**Required Scope:** hr:shifts:write (or hr:write, *)

get.description:
Returns configured reward and incentive types with eligibility rules.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

post.description:
Define a new financial or non-financial reward type with calculation method, value, and trigger conditions.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

patch.description:
Updates definition, calculation formula, or status of an existing reward type.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

post.summary: Manually execute automated evaluation for reward type
post.description:
Runs evaluation engine for a reward type across active employees for specified month/year. Creates reward records preventing duplicates.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

200.description: Evaluation executed successfully with summary and created records

400.description: Reward type inactive or invalid month/year

get.description:
Fetches approval workflow, payroll integration, evaluation schedules, and notification preferences.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

put.description:
Updates reward workflow settings, approvals, and evaluation calendar.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

get.description:
Lists configured attendance commitment bonus rules with parsed eligibility conditions and absence thresholds.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

200.description: List of reward rules with unpacked absence conditions

post.description:
Defines a new attendance commitment bonus rule specifying maximum allowed monthly absence days and bonus amount.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

targetEmployeeId.description: Optional: Restrict rule to a specific employee ID or employeeNumber

get.summary: Get attendance commitment reward rule by ID
get.description:
Fetches a single attendance commitment rule by ID with unpacked conditions.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:read` (or `hr:read`, `*`)

patch.description:
Updates rule properties such as bonus value, maximum allowed absence days, or active status.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

post.summary: Monthly evaluation of attendance commitment bonus rule
post.description:
Evaluates employee monthly absences against the rule's threshold using attendanceService. In dryRun mode, returns absence days and eligibility without persisting records. In live execution, generates approved reward records that seamlessly flow as bonuses into the payroll of that month.

**Required Scope:** `hr:rewards:write` (or `hr:write`, `*`)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Optional year if month is passed as integer

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: If true, simulates evaluation without creating records

200.description: Evaluation completed with summary, employee absence counts, and created reward records

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: MaxP Scoped HR API Key format: hrk_{16_hex_prefix}_{48_hex_secret}

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded (120 req/min, burst 30 per worker)
